heading: Content and visuals in rhythm
subtext: Alternating rows of text and media that tell a story as users scroll.

items.title: Visual storytelling
items.description: Each row pairs compelling copy with a media panel. The alternation keeps the reader engaged.

items.title: Mobile-aware reflow
items.description: On small screens, each row collapses to a stacked card. No side-by-side squish.

items.title: Media flexibility
items.description: Drop in images, gradients, code snippets, or custom HTML as the visual panel.

items.title: Theme alignment
items.description: Media panels inherit surface and border tokens, staying cohesive with the page.
